weather.title: Ogden Valley weather update: Oct. 13–18
weather.summary: Showers and thunderstorms tonight and Tuesday (94% chance Tuesday), with the snow level near 7,300 feet so the high peaks may turn white while the Valley floor stays rain. Lows of 29–32° every night through Friday, so cover tender plants and unhook hoses. Dry and sunny Thursday through Sunday, warming to the mid-60s. Air quality is Good.
weather.alt: Ogden Valley weather update for Oct. 13 to 18: a six-day forecast with Tuesday wet at 94 percent, then sunny Thursday through Sunday, plus boxes on showers and thunder, frost nights, snow up high, a sunny weekend, and a get-ready checklist.
weather.source: National Weather Service point forecast for the Eden, Liberty and Huntsville area, issued 10:01 p.m. Oct. 12, 2026; Utah Division of Air Quality forecast, issued 6:27 p.m. Oct. 12

weather.title: Ogden Valley storm briefing: Oct. 9–14
weather.summary: Leftovers of Tropical Storm Rachel. Wettest day Sunday, Oct. 11, with 1 to 3 inches of rain late Saturday to Monday morning, creeks running fast by Sunday evening, and snow levels dropping to 8,500–9,000 feet Monday to Wednesday.
weather.alt: Ogden Valley storm briefing for Oct. 9 to 14: a six-day forecast with Sunday the wettest day, plus boxes on heavy rain, creeks and roads, wind, snow up high, and a get-ready checklist.
weather.source: National Weather Service Salt Lake City forecast discussion, issued 2:55 p.m. Oct. 8, 2026; KSL and KUTV, Oct. 8

roads.title: North Ogden Divide repair · Oct. 20
roads.text: Starts Tuesday, Oct. 20, around 8 a.m. Work lasts 1 to 2 days. Message boards go up Friday, Oct. 16.
roads.alt: North Ogden Divide repair: Weber County Roads fixing failing asphalt starting Tuesday, Oct. 20 around 8 a.m. for 1 to 2 days, with flaggers running one-way traffic and about 5-minute delays

roads.title: Ogden Canyon lane closure (SR-39)
roads.text: Start date is tentative. Work could begin as early as Monday, Oct. 26. The confirmed date will be posted at ogdencitypipeline.com once the pipe arrives.
roads.alt: Ogden Canyon lane closure: one lane of SR-39 closed for about a quarter mile between The Oaks Restaurant and the Ogden Canyon Water Treatment Plant, alternating traffic 24/7, 5 to 10 minute delays, as early as Oct. 26, 2026 through April 2027
